batch_seed_rule: 42 + batch_index * 100003; deterministic pairing, not seed optimization
guidance_window: Read dynamically from frozen learning reference; currently [0,.5]. Last .49->.50 injection, native continuation to 1.
local_hypothesis: A selected correlated NOS regional acceptable set permits more coordinate/graph freedom than global point-cloud attraction while retaining endpoint regional advantages.
reference: At each discovery time, equal-batch mass and conditional within-batch selection probabilities; center of the selected 2D ASN117/VAL116 distribution; 50 percent Mahalanobis radius; native within-batch covariance.
learned_status: Association-based controlled hypothesis; not a learned causal intervention law. Single ellipse can bridge modes.
dose: eta=.10 exploratory pilot; native RMS multiplied by residual saturation gate, so near-boundary dose tends continuously to zero. Same .025 A per-atom and 1.25 A cumulative limits as global comparator.
gradient_scope: Full live endpoint pullback; local output observable can create nonlocal current-coordinate gradient. Noncore injection measured.
reference_energy: Only finite converged same-graph terminal MMFF94s local relaxation relief; no physical energy defined on noisy categorical intermediate states.
readouts: t=.5 and t=1 regional feature persistence

decision_rule.engineering_gate: Exact window; 100-step completion; no resampling; finite gradients; real-model finite differences; identical starting state and master seed across arms.
decision_rule.quality_gate: Reject promotion if valid or PB-fast passing yield decreases by more than 5 percentage points versus matched native, or if finite converged energy coverage is substantially lower without explanation.
decision_rule.local_effect_screen: Require lower endpoint regional deficit at window end before interpreting final outcome changes as regional intervention success. If absent, inspect gradient path and actual dose before increasing strength.
decision_rule.full_hypothesis_support: Report as supported only if local advantage persists at t=1, unique yield exceeds historical Steer, valid-pose target prediction and MMFF strain are at least as favorable as Steer, and surrounding geometry does not worsen. Report mixed outcomes without collapsing them into a favorable composite score.
decision_rule.selection_scope: These are two development batches, not independent validation or proof of generalization. Last round can expand to four batches under seed42; reused batches remain development data.
decision_rule.stop: May stop before five rounds when no interpretable benefit, invalid surrogate, resource failure, or sufficient limited conclusion; every started round and engineering failure is recorded.

retention: Before each next round, delete previous generated structures, trajectories, caches and archives after preserving reports, candidate metric/failure tables, config, source commit and hashes. Preserve original SMC and checkpoints.
reproducibility: Evidence, formulas and decision summaries are retained; no private chain-of-thought.
